newsitem.title: USA: Stage Stores says unit closes tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Stage Stores says unit closes tender offer.

text.p: Stage Stores Inc said Monday its wholly owned subsidiary, Specialty Retailers Inc, has accepted for payment all validly tendered securities in connection with the previously announced offers to purchase its outstanding 10 and 11 percent notes.
Stage Stores said it scheduled the payment date for the tender offer, which expired on June 13, for June 17.
Holders who tendered the 10 percent Senior Notes due 2000 will receive $1,056.03 per $1,000 principal amount.
Holders who tendered the 11 percent Series B and D Senior Subordinated Notes due 2003 will receive $1,098.39 per $1,000 principal amount.
Stage Stores operates 328 department stores in 20 states under the names Stage, Bealls and Palais Royal.
